KEEP LEARNING

LambdaMOO and ToastStunt programming resources

Source code, manuals, tutorials, and people to help you build beyond the learning workspace.

Native servers support features that this browser environment does not. Match documentation to the server and core you are using; the Academy’s parser and runtime limitations are described separately.

ToastStunt source and documentation

  • ToastStunt source — the server repository, feature overview, and build instructions.
  • ToastStunt Programmer’s Manual — language, server, and builtin documentation.
  • ToastStunt documentation repository — additional function references and documentation source.
  • ToastCore — a core database for ToastStunt and the source of the Academy’s Common Packages utilities.

LambdaMOO source and documentation

LambdaMOO 1.9.0alpha is the newest published alpha listed on the maintainer’s release page, checked September 17, 2026.

  • Maintained LambdaMOO source — the current server repository.
  • LambdaMOO 1.9.0alpha release notes — the alpha’s changes, testing status, and documentation guidance.
  • Download the 1.9.0alpha source archive — the maintainer’s release distribution.
  • 1.9.0alpha README and build documentation — start here for release-specific setup and configuration.
  • Updated LambdaMOO Programmer’s Manual — an expanded reference for the 1.8-era language and server model.

The maintainer notes that there is no dedicated 1.9.0 programmer’s manual yet. Use the alpha’s README and release notes alongside the language manual; the older manual does not describe every alpha extension. The Academy’s LambdaMOO profile is an educational subset, not a complete implementation of the alpha.
